_comment: « حصّة القسم » — the DEFAULT class tests of lesson « خاصية طالس وحساب الأطوال » (docs/architecture/CLASS_SESSION.md §4). `start` opens the hour: what the lesson stands on (the fourth proportional and the cross product, 3am.m1.r08; the proportional lengths of a triangle cut by a parallel, 3am.m2.r03), then two questions of the NEW lesson asked in plain geometric words, never with the name of a key (`teaser`: a length when the data are a piece of a side, a length when the points are on the other side of the meeting point — asked again at the end with other numbers and the same answer). `end` closes it on the four keys and the three الكفاءات of the lesson (all one item of the learning net, 4am.m2.r01; P1 the three equal ratios, nested and butterfly, e3 e4; P2 a length, pieces included, e1 e2 e5; P3 the coefficient k, its direction and enlargement or reduction, e6 e7 e8). `pool` holds more prepared questions a teacher may add to his own copy. The numbers are the platform's own: none of the lesson's exercise bank, none of the student's world (PYRAMIDS_WORLD_PLAN.md §3.8), none of the board (scripts/lesson-bank-numbers.mjs). A number answer is a whole number (the board's keypad has digits only); a fraction is asked as a choice. Every question carries a `check` from which its answer is RE-COMPUTED, exactly, by a test (defaultTests.test.js): a default test never ships a wrong answer. A class test never changes a student's progress.
